name: Skill First Learn
description: Official registry for Skillfirst Learn Workspaces.

workspaces.description: Essential Python for Robotics - Practice Lab Environment with ROS2/Gazebo integration, featuring interactive Python learning modules and a comprehensive capstone project.

Essential ROS 2 & Gazebo for Robotics — Kasm-style practice lab: four step-based modules (nodes/topics, rclpy, TurtleBot 3 in Gazebo, capstone /cmd_vel logic), ROS 2 Humble, Gazebo simulation, VS Code workspace, and Tkinter lab instructions.

IoT Security Workshop 4 - MQTT Security vLab featuring hands-on tasks for installing, analyzing, securing, and encrypting MQTT communication. Includes Mosquitto broker, Wireshark analysis, authentication, and TLS encryption for comprehensive IoT security training.
workspaces.notes: This workspace requires TASK_ID environment variable (1-4) to launch specific lab tasks. Configure 4 separate Kasm workspaces with TASK_ID=1, 2, 3, and 4 respectively. Each task focuses on different MQTT security aspects: installation, traffic analysis, authentication, and TLS encryption.

workspaces.description: Robotics PBL vLab workspace featuring ROS2 Humble, Gazebo simulation, and Unitree Go2 robot in a simple hospital environment. Designed for Project-Based Learning: Building Real-World Robots (Guide Dog and Security Patrol).
SFL PBL Demo workspace featuring Unitree Go2 with ROS2 and Gazebo for robotics simulation. Designed for hands-on Project-Based Learning in autonomous robotics.
Unitree Go2 Virtual Lab environment with ROS2 and Gazebo for robotics simulation, hosted on GHCR.
The Skillfirst Learn Virtual Lab environment, featuring ROS2 and Gazebo (Version 2) hosted privately on GHCR.
